heroBody: Explore the machinery farmers use to prepare the land, protect crops and bring in the harvest.
categoryBody: Sample categories for each stage of the farming season.
tillageBody: Prepare your land for the next crop.
droneBody: Apply crop protection across the field.
harvestBody: Bring in crops with a combine harvester.
rotavatorBody: Break up soil and prepare a seedbed.
how1Body: Register as a farmer or service provider.
how2Body: See sample categories for field preparation, crop care and harvest.
how3Body: Save your contact details and language preference.
aboutBody: Mana Yantram is a farm machinery and services marketplace. This release introduces accounts and separate workspaces for farmers, service providers and department officers.
helpBody: Sign in with your username and password. Farmers and service providers can register. Department accounts are provisioned separately.
termsBody: Use this demonstration to explore account features. Provide accurate details and keep your password private.
privacyBody: This demonstration stores account, consent, session and audit records to operate and secure your account.
denied: You do not have permission to access this page.
authTitle: Machinery for every stage of the season.
auth2: Create a farmer or provider account
auth3: Use Mana Yantram in English or Telugu
farmerDesc: Discover machinery services and track bookings.
providerDesc: List equipment, offer services and manage requests.
loginIntro: Sign in to your Mana Yantram account.
chooseAccountBody: Select the role that fits how you’ll use Mana Yantram.
usernameHint: 3–50 letters, numbers, periods, underscores or hyphens.
passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. Spaces and passphrases are allowed.
acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use.
onboardingBody: Detailed agricultural profiles will be available in the next milestone. You can edit your account details now.
selectAuthorized: Select a role for this session.
farmerOverview: Review your account and explore agricultural services.
providerOverview: Review your onboarding and service provider workspace.
adminOverview: Review your assigned role and upcoming department modules.
passwordChanged: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
logoutAllBody: You’ll need to sign in again on each device.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
usernameInvalid: Use 3–50 letters, numbers, periods, underscores or hyphens.
consentRequired: You must accept this policy to continue.
accountDeactivated: Your account has been deactivated. Contact the department.
passwordChangeRequired: Change your temporary password to continue.
mobileTaken: That mobile number is already in use.
roleNotGrantable: You cannot grant or manage that role.
outOfJurisdiction: That location is outside your jurisdiction.
invalidState: This action is not allowed in the current state.
operatorOverview: See the equipment assigned to you.
noAssignedEquipment: No equipment has been assigned to you yet.
usersIntro: Create and manage department accounts within your jurisdiction.
shareOnceBody: The temporary password is shown only now. The user must change it at first sign-in.
temporaryPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. The user must change it at first sign-in.
createUserIntro: The new user signs in with a temporary password and must change it.
deactivateBody: The user is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until reactivated.
resetPasswordBody: Set a new temporary password. The user is signed out and must change it at next sign-in.
confirmResetBody: The current password stops working immediately.
reasonShort: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.
forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Contact your provider, field agent or the department helpdesk.
mustChangeNotice: You are using a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
addRoleProvider: Also register as a Service Provider
addRoleBody: Use one account for both roles and switch between them any time.
fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to {{mb}} MB.
fileTypeNotAllowed: That file type is not allowed.
uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.
photosHint: Up to {{max}} photos (JPG, PNG or WebP).
geoDenied: Location access was denied. Enter the coordinates instead.
geoTimeout: Finding your location took too long.
aadhaarHint: Only the last 4 digits are stored.
aadhaarKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the saved number. Only the last 4 digits are stored.
aadhaarTaken: That Aadhaar number is already registered.
notifyStoredOnly: Preferences are saved now; notifications will start in a later release.
farmerOnboardingBody: Tell us a little about yourself so service providers can reach your farm.
farmerProfileIntro: Keep your details up to date.
plotLimit: You can keep at most 50 plots.
plotsIntro: The land plots where you want machinery services.
firstPlotIntro: Add your first plot now, or skip and do it later.
deletePlotBody: It will no longer appear in your plot list.
extentInvalid: Enter an extent between 0.01 and 1000 acres (up to 2 decimals).
assistedIntro: Farmers you have registered on their behalf.
assistedFormIntro: Create an account and profile for a farmer. They sign in with a temporary password and must change it.
assistedConsent: I have explained the terms and privacy notice to the farmer and they consented.
assistedShareBody: Give these details to the farmer now. The password is not shown again and must be changed at first sign-in.
statusMessage_DRAFT: Complete the checklist and submit for verification.
statusMessage_SUBMITTED: Under review by the department. Editing is locked.
statusMessage_RETURNED: Fix the highlighted items and resubmit.
statusMessage_APPROVED: Your application is approved. You can now receive bookings.
statusMessage_REJECTED: Your application was rejected. See the remarks from the department.
statusMessage_SUSPENDED: Your account is suspended. Contact the department.
statusMessage_BLACKLISTED: Your account has been blacklisted. Contact the department.
typeHint_INDIVIDUAL: A person who owns and rents out machinery.
typeHint_AGENCY: A company or agency offering services.
registrationRequired: A registration number is required for this provider type.
profileLocked: The profile cannot be edited while the application is in this state.
providerOnboardingBody: Choose your provider type and tell us about your unit.
documentsIntro: Upload each required document. The department reviews them one by one.
documentsLocked: Provider documents are locked in this state. Equipment documents can still be updated.
bankIntro: Add the account where payouts will be sent.
bankLocked: Bank details cannot be changed in this state.
accountMismatch: The account numbers do not match.
bankVerifiedManually: An officer verifies the account against your bank proof document.
capacityPair: Give both the capacity and its unit, or neither.
equipmentIntro: Machines you offer, with photos, units and rates.
numberOfUnitsHint: Each machine becomes a unit you can book separately.
equipmentCreated: Equipment added. Now set your rates.
unitRegistrationInvalid: Use a registration like TS09AB1234 (no spaces).
noServices: No services on the rate card yet.
rateMin: The rate must be at least ₹1.00.
workRateHint: How much area this machine covers in an hour.
freeRadiusHint: No travel charge within this distance.
equipmentLocked: Equipment cannot be changed while the application is in this state.
serviceExists: This operation is already on the rate card.
unitLimit: An equipment can have at most 50 units.
rateAboveCap: The rate is above the allowed maximum.
timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
coverage_RADIUS: Within a distance of my base
radiusHint: From your base location, 1 to 100 km.
radiusInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
workingHoursHint: Tick the days you work and set your hours.
coverageIntro: Where you work and when you are available.
coverageLocked: Coverage and hours cannot be changed while the application is in this state.
noEquipmentToAssign: Add equipment first to assign it.
operatorShareBody: Give these details to the operator now. The password is not shown again and must be changed at first sign-in.
operatorsIntro: People who drive your machines. They sign in with a username and temporary password.
addOperatorIntro: Create an account for an operator and choose the machines they can use.
operatorsLocked: Operators cannot be changed while the application is in this state.
operatorDeactivateBody: The operator is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until activated again.
operatorActivateBody: Allow this operator to sign in again.
availabilityIntro: Block the dates when a machine cannot work, such as servicing or repairs.
block_order: The end must be after the start.
block_past: The period must end in the future.
block_long: A block can last at most 180 days.
blockOverlap: That period overlaps another block for this machine.
noUnitsToBlock: Add equipment first; each machine unit can then be blocked.
confirmSubmitBody: The application will be locked while the department reviews it.
completeChecklistFirst: Complete every checklist item to submit.
applicationIncomplete: Some required items are missing or not yet accepted.
adminProvidersIntro: Applications from service providers in your jurisdiction.
returnItemBody: The provider sees your remarks and must replace the item.
confirmRevealBody: This action is recorded in the audit log.
noBank: No bank account has been added.
coverageRadiusSummary: Within {{km}} km of the base location
approveDisabledWhy: Accept every required document and the bank account first.
returnApplicationBody: Your general remarks and the field remarks entered above are sent to the provider.
rejectBody: Rejection is final. The provider cannot edit or resubmit.
rateCapsDescription: Set maximum rates providers may charge. Caps apply only while enforcement is on.
rateCapsEnforcementHelp: When on, providers cannot save a rate above the cap for their district (or the statewide cap). Existing rates are not changed.
enableRateCapsBody: Providers will be stopped from saving rates above the caps below.
disableRateCapsBody: Providers will be able to set any rate again. The caps are kept.
capExists: A cap already exists for that category, operation, district and basis.
capIncomplete: Choose a category and operation and enter a maximum of at least ₹1.
